name: strategy-lab-web
description: Research and a result's popup, live from the app's database: React + TypeScript, built by Vite into dist/, which the server (python -m server) serves.

scripts.api: npx --yes -p typescript@5.9.3 -p openapi-typescript@7.13.0 openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/api/schema.ts
scripts.check:render: vite build --ssr check/render.tsx --outDir check/out --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node check/out/render.js
